facts.text: Bucky's Tuition Promise pays tuition and segregated fees for four years for new Wisconsin residents whose household income is $65,000 or less. Assets don't count, and there's no separate application, only the FAFSA (and, for fall 2026 entrants, the CSS Profile).

sources.title: UW–Madison Financial Aid, Bucky's Tuition Promise

facts.text: For Pell-eligible Wisconsin residents, Bucky's Pell Pathway goes further: grants, scholarships and work-study that meet full financial need, including housing and food, for four years.

sources.title: UW–Madison Financial Aid, Bucky's Pell Pathway
